name: check_task
description: Read the environment-owned faithful LIBERO task result. Use when: physical and visual evidence suggests the requested task may be complete, and always before finish_episode(outcome=success). Effect: read-only; it queries the only policy-visible official task checker. Returns: task_success when the checker is available, or a retryable task_checker_unavailable result. Does not: change the world, explain why the task passed or failed, expose the hidden predicate, or substitute for physical verification during manipulation. On error: Refused: any argument (invalid_arguments). Wait for the Runtime to expose the checker and retry; never infer official success from tool or motion success.
